tsaUrl.description: URL of the RFC 3161 Time Stamp Authority (TSA) server. Must be one of the built-in presets (DigiCert, Sectigo, SSL.com, FreeTSA, MeSign) or an admin-configured URL in settings.yml (security.timestamp.customTsaUrls). If omitted, the server default is used (security.timestamp.defaultTsaUrl, DigiCert unless changed).
